calendar_omissions.FOMC: not included -- no verifiable, freezable list of the ~160 scheduled meeting dates over 1993-2026 was obtainable inside the frozen-data constraint, and there is no deterministic rule to derive them. Writing dates from memory would inject fabricated data into a milestone whose entire point is not trusting unverified inputs.
calendar_omissions.CPI: not included -- same reason. BLS release dates vary within the month and follow no rule recomputable from the index.
calendar_omissions.consequence: candidate family 5 (calendar) is therefore tested on OPEX, month-end, quarter-end and the first-Friday NFP convention only. This is a REDUCED version of the specified family and is reported as such, not as the full test.
